description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Pulse-period–moment-magnitude relations derived with wavelet analysis and their relevance to estimate structural deformations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Elina Efthymiou, The University of Texas at Tyler. Motivated from the quadratic dependence of peak structural displacements to the pulse period, 𝑇𝑝, of pulse-like ground motions, this paper revisits the pulse-period – moment-magnitude (𝑇𝑝–𝑀w) relations of ground motions generated from recorded near-source ground motions with epicentral distances, 𝐷 ≤20 km. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-g8r1-gg85. Keywords: faulting mechanisms, near-source effects, pulse period, pulse-like ground motions, wavelet analysis. Published 2024-08-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
